prompt:
Do not change the girl’s appearance from the photo. Selfie on the front camera with an outstretched arm, side angle. The girl stands sideways to the camera.

Her long straight hair with a natural shine is blown by the wind, thickly covering part of her face and chest, creating a light veil over her lips.

Makeup: even skin tone, dark laminated brows, long black winged eyeliner, lush extended lashes in a “fox eye” effect, plump lips in a natural shade.

She is wearing a white cropped ribbed long-sleeve top made of thin cotton, with a gathered drawstring at the front (the ties are slightly visible), and slightly visible low-rise black jeans at the waist. Hourglass figure — very slim waist. Manicure: milky long pointed nails.

One arm is bent at the elbow and raised to her forehead, completely covering the eye, as if she is about to fix her hair. Facial expression is calm and confident, looking over her shoulder at the camera.

Lighting: very bright daytime sun, “golden hour,” beautiful sharp shadows.

Background: green bushes, trees, sidewalk, the corner of a brick multi-story residential building in orange-red color.

promptsmv. Photo taken on iPhone 17 Pro, live-frame look. Light digital noise, grain, soft sharpness. High detail of skin and fabric texture. Very high quality. 2:3.

translations.zh: 不要改变照片中女孩的外貌。前置摄像头伸展手臂自拍，侧面角度。女孩侧身对向镜头。长直发被风吹拂，略微遮挡面部。妆容精致，身穿白色短款螺纹长袖上衣与低腰黑牛仔裤。单臂抬至额前遮眼，神情从容自信。黄金时刻阳光照射，背景包含绿植与红砖建筑。
translations.en: Front-camera outstretched selfie of a young woman at golden hour. Long hair blowing across her face, one hand raised to her forehead, dressed in a white cropped long-sleeve top and low-rise black jeans with a residential brick building and greenery behind her.
